scope: Real uploaded THz spectra, anonymous7groups, retrospective within-batch; not exact regression paper reproduction

base_source.selection: source-only development lock; never chosen from final scores
base_source.preprocessing: reuse locked SNV/source StandardScaler/optional PCA; no target refit

meta_training.inner_loss: unweighted CE on disjoint source support
meta_training.fomaml_outer_loss: source-episode query first-order gradient plus full-source CE gradient with anchor weight1
meta_training.supervised_control: same source tasks/query CE plus full-source CE gradient; no fast inner weights
meta_training.full_source_class_weight: reuse locked base source candidate none/balanced
meta_training.class_eligibility: at least2 source physical specimens; dev excludesZY02 from meta only, all7 retained in full-source supervision; final source includesall7

target_adaptation.objective: target support CE + full source CE(weight1, source class weighting) + .1*sum(parameter-source_parameter)^2
target_adaptation.matched_zero: identical optimizer/source replay/proximal steps with targetCE omitted

selection.rank: highest absolute mean adaptedaccuracy among eligible; lower meta updates, lower innerLR, lower targetLR, fewer targetsteps, candidateID
selection.fallback: reference m000 (100updates,innerLR.001) FO source zero; no target adaptation
selection.diagnostic: best development absoluteaccuracy FO candidate, even if ineligible; best supervised continuation target candidate separately

final.stage_gate: All four round development choices must lock before root invokes any final stage; this command defaults development
